title_zh: 确认社区花园提案的短时会面

scenario.label_zh: 确认短时会面及助理接待安排
scenario.goal_zh: 向议员助理说明城市花园设想，确认短时会面并约定先交一页说明

context_zh: 虚构社区提案预约，不涉及真实议员或政治游说。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: I'm hoping to discuss an urban garden on the empty lot. Are you the councillor's aide?

sentences.speaker: Brent
sentences.text: Yes. What would you want the meeting to focus on?

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: Our vision is a place where residents can grow food together. At this stage, we're asking about the process, not approval to build.

sentences.speaker: Brent
sentences.text: We have a slot on Tuesday at three, albeit a short one. You would have fifteen minutes.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: That's enough for an initial conversation. Could I send a one-page outline first?

sentences.speaker: Brent
sentences.text: Please do. I'll include it in the briefing and meet you at reception at five to three.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll send the outline and come to reception then.
